decisions.notes: A simple cylindrical brown barrel with three raised rings and a circular top cap; all orbit, top, underside, clay and wireframe views plus the enlarged oblique render were inspected.
limitations: Static, stylized barrel with a flat material, not a textured or openable container.
Target-engine collision has not been tested.

decisions.notes: A complete blue crate with thick corner posts and recessed panels on its sides and lid; all twelve inspection views and the enlarged oblique render were inspected.
limitations: Static stylized crate with a flat material; the lid is not animated.
Target-engine collision has not been tested.
